description: Source code for the client component of the Emergency Access Daemon (EAD), implementing network communication, authentication, and command execution over UDP.

methods.name: set_nonblock
methods.description: Sets socket to non-blocking mode based on enable flag.

methods.name: send_packet
methods.description: Sends a packet of specified type and handles responses with a handler function, up to a maximum number of responses.

methods.name: prepare_password
methods.description: Prepares the password for authentication, applying MD5 hashing if configured.

methods.name: handle_pong
methods.description: Handles pong response, updates authentication state.

methods.name: handle_prime
methods.description: Handles prime/salt message, initializes cryptographic parameters.

methods.name: handle_b
methods.description: Handles B value received from server.

methods.name: handle_cmd_data
methods.description: Handles command data received, decrypts and outputs it.

methods.name: send_ping
methods.description: Sends a ping message to discover devices.

methods.name: send_a
methods.description: Sends A value for key exchange.

methods.name: send_command
methods.description: Sends a command to the server.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage information for the program.
